description: This file contains utility functions for formatting and transforming messages in Nextcloud Talk, including markdown conversion, escaping characters, formatting mentions, code blocks, inline code, stripping formatting, and truncating text.

methods.name: export function markdownToNextcloudTalk(text: string): string { markdownToNextcloudTalk

methods.description: Escapes special markdown characters in text to prevent interpretation.

methods.name: export function formatNextcloudTalkInlineCode(code: string): string { formatNextcloudTalkInlineCode

methods.name: export function stripNextcloudTalkFormatting(text: string): string { stripNextcloudTalkFormatting
